name: record_entities
description: Record the entities extracted from the search query.

vibe.description: The mood/activity the user is after, with time, place, and handle removed. Null if the query is purely entities.

location.description: A neighborhood, venue, or city name mentioned in the query. Null if absent.

start.description: ISO 8601 start of the implied window

end.description: ISO 8601 end of the implied window

username.description: A handle the user is searching for, without the @ prefix. Null if absent.
